exposure: low-molecular-weight heparin (LMWH) type (dalteparin, enoxaparin, other LMWHs)
cohort: Pregnant women with acute venous thromboembolism (VTE) who initiated therapeutic doses of low-molecular-weight heparin (LMWH) within 15 days of an incident VTE.
finding: The study found no significant differences in major bleeding risk associated with different LMWH types (dalteparin, enoxaparin, or other LMWHs) or dosing frequencies (once-daily vs. twice-daily) in pregnant women with VTE.
